checks.text: The page shows the heading "Scientific Calculator" and the text "Enter an expression" in the input panel.
Typing "2 + 3 * 4" in the field labelled "Expression" and pressing the button "Evaluate" shows "14" in the field labelled "Result".
Typing "sin(30)" in the field labelled "Expression" and pressing the button "Evaluate" shows "0.5" in the field labelled "Result".
Typing "log(1000)" in the field labelled "Expression" and pressing the button "Evaluate" shows "3" in the field labelled "Result".
Typing "2 ^ 10" in the field labelled "Expression" and pressing the button "Evaluate" shows "1024" in the field labelled "Result".

After evaluating "sin(x)" with "Degrees" selected in the select labelled "Angle mode", the chart tab has a point `x=30, y=0.5`; after selecting "Radians" and evaluating again it has a point `x=30, y=-0.988`.
Clicking the button "Copy result" after evaluating "2 + 3" copies "5" to the clipboard.
The history list shows "2 + 3 = 5" after the first evaluation; clicking the button "Clear history" removes all items and shows "No history".
Reload keeps the expression "2 + 3" in the field labelled "Expression" and the history item "2 + 3 = 5".
